text:
alexa: Quick sanity check — our headroom model predicts 35% GPU headroom for eu-west1 during the Q3 promo week. I'm not convinced; can someone sanity-check tokens/sec assumptions? Details: model mix shifted to 70% cherry-7b-quant, avg seq=512, concurrency=1200, p95 target=250ms.

malik: That concurrency seems high for 7b with batch_size=8. Did you factor KV-cache hit rate? Last load test had cache_hit=42% which buys ~30% throughput.

malik: Quick calc I used to sanity-check: 
```
# rough per-token time (ms) = base_token + seq_dependent
base = 0.9
per_token = 0.002
tokens_per_req = 512
latency_ms = base + tokens_per_req * per_token
```
Not precise but helps ballpark. If per_token is 0.002ms we get ~1.9ms per request token processing, times 512 => ~973ms raw, so batching + KV hit matters a lot.

sophia: Autoscaler note — we're still scaling on pod CPU usage for the infra group. For inference we should switch to GPU_util or queue_length. Also consider setting min_replicas=4 for peak week so churn doesn't kill cold-start latency.

jamie: Doing a quick throughput->GPU-hours estimate: if avg concurrency sustained is 900 (accounting for retries & queue) and avg latency/inflight is 0.25s, that's ~900 * 0.25 = 225 qps. For cherry-7b on our HW that's ~40k tokens/sec per GPU (with batching/kv). So tokens/sec => GPU count => hours.
jamie: I ran a sim: ~380 GPU-hours/day in eu-west1 for the promo profile. Cost @ $2.4/hr => ~ $912/day. That scales quickly if we mis-estimate headroom. :grimacing: 

infra-bot: [node-reaper] Preemption spike detected on 3 nodes in eu-west1 at 1795123468 — 2 recovered, 1 replaced.

leo: Two mitigation options: 1) enable region spillover to us-central with lower-fidelity routing (route 20% traffic to 3b variants), 2) set conservative headroom target 20% instead of 35% and enable model-fallback for cold paths. Also temporarily reduce max_batch_size to 6 for p95 safety. :thinking_face:

alexa: Agreed. Can someone own the 30-min soak test (eu-west1 + us-central spillover + fallback to 3b) and a short runbook for on-call? I'll update the capacity forecast sheet after results. :thumbsup:

malik: I can run the soak monday 09:00 UTC, will push a test config to staging and drop a link here once ready.

sophia: I'll add GPU_util autoscaling patch to the PR queue and ping infra oncall to review.

jamie: I'll update the cost sheet with both 20% and 35% headroom rows and include estimates for spillover.

alexa: Perfect — thanks team. If the soak shows >25% variance from model, we throttle promo traffic or enable A/B fallback immediately.
